title: SEWANTA Wide Mouth Mason Jars 32 oz [4 Pack] With Mason Jar Lids and Bands, Mason Jars 32 oz - For Canning, Fermenting, Pickling - Jar Decor - Microwave/Freeze/Dishwasher Safe.
description:
About this item
4 PACK MASON JARS 32 OZ WIDE MOUTH: Perfect for canning, pickling, preserving, and fermenting fruits and veggies that can be canned and sealed for up to 18 Months. Embossed measurement markings for precise filling. Label line for writing dates and identifying contents.
DURABLE GLASS CONSTRUCTION: Made in America soda-lime glass, USDA approved and,Toxin-free ensuring food grade quality. Heat-tempered durability for water bath canning, microwave and dishwasher safe; clear glass jars for easy visibility; wide mouth canning jars for easy filling and washing.

reviews_1s:
The absolute worse mason jars. Bought 8 of them. Within one month 6 of them cracked in the freezer. They were cooled slowly, outside at 50 degree temps. Than overnight in fridge, once cold I froze them. Left enough room for expansion but Just went to defrost one and saw broken jar. Took out the other 3, all cracked. Will never buy this brand again!Terrible, these break when exposed to hot water. I've had 3 shatter now. I use them for formula and it's crazy. I thought they were crack resistant. Terrible productThese jars are a rip off. I mistakenly bought them and didn’t realize I can get 12 32oz jars for the same price anywhere else.2 out of the four jars have shattered in the fridge and freezer. I cut my thumb cleaning the mess (I should’ve worn gloves) but they shouldn’t have marketed this as freezer safe when it clearly isn’t.

I made sure to put room temperature gels and produce in the jars before I cooled them and, left space to expand yet they still ended up shattered.I use jars to freeze bone broth and soups for long term storage. I'm always careful to not fill fully due to expansion. All four jars have cracked when frozen and shattered in the defrost process. Never had this problem with Ball, Kerr or Atlas jars. I'll stick with those in the futureI bought these mason jars to infuse a detox tea. When I poured the hot water in it, the jar cracked. I lost use if the tea because it was not safe to consume it after that. I then lift the jar to dispose of the water and the bottom gave way causing a spilling, I was almost burnt with the hot water. Not safe for hot products.I can dog food for my dogs meals and this is the 3rd glass jar that has been brought out of the freezer with a crack. I don’t understand why or how this is happening.
Plenty of room for expansion
Food is chilled in the fridge before frozen

What a waste of food, time, and money
Nothing is made to last todaySays they’re freezer safe and all of them cracked immediately when I stored liquids in the freezer within the first 30mins.
